title: Ukrainian Pasta Bake
description: A hearty, cheesy pasta bake inspired by Ukrainian cuisine. Perfect for a comforting dinner.

ingredients.name: pasta
ingredients.notes: penne or other short pasta shape

ingredients.name: ukrainian cheese
ingredients.notes: or substitute with feta or ricotta

instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, tomato mixture, and Ukrainian cheese.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional Ukrainian cheese.
Bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
